enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch arms. Yawn. Continue sleeping. Roll onto back. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn again. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face with water. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Take out mug and tea bag. Fill kettle with water and turn on. Remove toast and spread butter. Pour hot water into mug and add tea bag. Sit at table. Eat toast and drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Put on clothes. Open drawer. Take out socks and put on. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place computer and charger in bag. Place phone in pocket. Zip bag. Pick up bag and walk out.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone for time. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, emails, and partner calls
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open email program. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone call to partner. Speak on phone. Take notes. Attend meeting with colleagues. Discuss program coordination. Update program schedule on computer. Print documents. File documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at a nearby cafe
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Stand in line. Order sandwich and coffee. Pay cashier. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink coffee. Check phone. Throw away trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: planning events, meeting with volunteers, updating program schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Return to office. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open event planning software. Create event timeline. Make phone call to venue. Speak with venue manager. Meet with volunteers in meeting room. Discuss event logistics. Assign tasks to volunteers. Update program schedule spreadsheet. Send email to partners. Print flyers. Post flyers on bulletin board. Organize supplies.
Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Arriving home, putting things down and resting briefly
enriched_activities.desc: Enter house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to living room. Put bag on sofa. Take off shoes. Sit on sofa. Lean back. Close eyes. Breathe. Stand up.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil and ingredients. Stir and cook. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Clear table. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Adjust sitting position. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower (deliberately after 8pm to avoid the water-heater peak tax)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and phone: personal admin, reading news, light relaxing activities
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open browser. Check personal emails. Pay bills online. Read news. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put phone down. Open document. Write personal notes. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Pick up phone. Read e-book. Put phone down. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Yawn. Remain still. Sleep.
